scope: Project-owned protocol v1 (ADR 0005), WASI preview 1 ABI, and the existing independently generated classic corpus. ISO 32000-2 clause locators 7.5, 7.7.3.3 and 7.8.2 are cited from the facade contract; full ISO text and upstream WASI specifications were not available offline for verification. No competitor source, tests or history was consulted.

requirements.status: frozen v1 including the distinct refused-repair field
requirements.gaps: Wire layout is project-owned and fixed in crates/pagura-host/PROTOCOL.md; no interoperability claim beyond v1.
No coverage-guided or sustained fuzzing, transport deadlines, cancellation, or OS memory-limit evidence.
Synchronous v1; no concurrent requests, handle reuse or within-request cancellation.

requirements.status: implemented for facade Error and Diagnostic fields
tests: tools/host_test.mjs structured Unsupported and strict-repair failures
requirements.gaps: No known field loss: errors preserve feature and refused repair separately, plus category/message/object/position.
Interactive pipe test validates flushing, structured failure and terminal exit; sustained I/O fault injection is separate.

requirements.status: verified for all 13 classic render cases and page 2 of two-pages
tests: tools/host_test.mjs browser-shim pixels and partial tile rows
requirements.gaps: This is correctness evidence on the declared generated subset, not general PDF conformance or performance evidence.

requirements.status: implemented and exercised through the actual shim
requirements.gaps: Browser runtime launch was sandbox-blocked. Node's WASI run explicitly passes empty args/env/preopens; browser shim returns empty args/env, no preopens and traps unknown imports by name.

requirements.status: implemented; viewer logic and Canvas inputs checked in DOM harness
requirements.gaps: Verified in a real browser: cross-origin isolation, exact pixels at device pixel ratio 2, navigation and the unsupported banner; picker and drop interaction are not automated. Multi-page navigation and startup loading pass the DOM harness. Password prompting is not implemented; raw password bytes are supported by the protocol client.

requirements.status: verified in-process, natively, in WASI, through the browser shim and in the viewer DOM harness
requirements.gaps: Real-browser navigation verified manually. Page 1 uses two-pages.ppm; page 2 expectations are independently computed from the stated blue-square geometry, including partial tiles.

requirements.status: implemented with opt-in read-only server routes and validated startup URL loading
requirements.gaps: Serving remains loopback-only and disabled unless --fixtures is supplied; only corpus/generated is exposed.
